units.source_text: 因此，上学的时候，信子和俊吉常常一起看展览、听音乐会，且每次自己的妹妹都会同行。

en.t: Therefore, when they were in school, Nobuko and Shunkichi often went together to see exhibitions and hear concerts, and Nobuko's younger sister came along every time.

units.source_text: 来回的路上，三个人有说有笑，只是偶尔，妹妹照子会插不上话。

en.t: On the way there and back, the three of them talked and laughed, though now and then the younger sister, Teruko, could not join in.

units.source_text: 不过，照子还是小孩子，边走边看橱窗里的太阳伞、丝绸披肩之类的，即使插不上话，她也不会不高兴。

en.t: But Teruko was still a child, and as she walked she looked at the parasols, silk shawls, and the like in the shop windows, so even if she could not join the conversation, she did not grow unhappy.

units.source_text: 不过信子如果察觉到，就一定会转换到能让妹妹参与进来的话题。

en.t: Still, whenever Nobuko noticed, she would always switch to a topic her younger sister could take part in.

units.source_text: 话虽如此，聊着聊着信子就又会忘了妹妹的情绪。

en.t: Even so, as the talk went on, Nobuko would again forget how her younger sister was feeling.

units.source_text: 俊吉似乎对这些并不在意，在络绎不绝的人流中，他总是一边说着有趣的笑话，一边悠闲的阔步前行。

en.t: Shunkichi seemed not to mind any of this; amid the unending stream of people, he always strode along at ease, telling amusing jokes as he went.
